description: This Java class 'VcapServicesStringParser' is a utility that parses VCAP services configuration strings into a Typesafe Config object. It handles JSON or HOCON formats and throws a custom error if parsing fails. The class is singleton and implements Function<String, Config>, with methods to parse, convert, and extract service details.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringParser
classes.description: A singleton utility class implementing Function<String, Config> that parses VCAP services JSON/HOCON strings into Typesafe Config objects, with handling for nested objects and error scenarios.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method to parse a VCAP services string into a Config object.

methods.name: tryToParseString
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a Config; throws a custom error with message if parsing fails.

methods.name: convertConfigListToConfigObject
methods.description: Converts a ConfigList into a ConfigObject with flattened keys.

methods.name: getAsConfigObject
methods.description: Creates a ConfigObject from a ConfigList, assigning keys based on object 'name' property or list index.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' field from a ConfigObject.
